title: Quebec City & Montmorency Falls Private Day Trip from Montreal
includes: Scenic stops and walking exploration in Old Quebec
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is more than a day of sightseeing — it’s a personal introduction to Quebec City, its history, culture, and character, experienced at a relaxed pace.

- Personally hosted by Kian 
- Stories that bring Quebec and Canadian history to life! From formation of the New France and the British conquest 
- Local insights along the way and the stories behind the places you visit
- Conversation, not a scripted tour! 
- Follow your interests, and make the experience your own
- A flexible day with time for photos, spontaneous stops, and the places you enjoy most
- Montmorency Falls admission & cable car included — one less thing to plan
